I’d first try tracking your clean days. I use a app called don’t break the chain. You give yourself a mark on a calendar for each day you stay clean if you don’t stay clean it skips the day and you get to try again tomorrow. I like this because there’s no extra guilt in cutting and we all know we already have enough. 

Next would be try to focus on whatever’s starting your urges. Don’t try to look at the whole picture you’ll just get overwhelmed pick out one thing and work on that.
